notes_for_editor: Build year 1933 agreed by the register and Forest Lookouts. Current condition and public access are unverified: no dated source read says the tower stands today, so the record's 'standing' rests on the register entry alone. A Forest Lookouts page for the lake lists a federal survey marker at the tower stamped TEPEE 1938; that is the marker's date, not the tower's. A NARA photo caption and a Facebook post surfaced only in search snippets and were not used. No corrections proposed. Fact-check 2026-10-09: 'has a cab' became 'was built with a cab' because no source confirms the tower stands today; the Kenton Ranger District sentence now cites the Forest Service page; the Iron County quote was added as evidence.
